query:
insert into ConfigCollectedSchemas (
                latest_collection,
                product_id,
                schema_hash,
                cfg_entry
            )
            values (
                $1,
                $2,
                $3,
                $4
            )
            on conflict (
                product_id,
                schema_hash,
                cfg_entry
            ) do update
            set
                latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection
